fatal_failures: production or test compilation fails from a clean clone
the exact public static AuditTradeState(String, Path, Path) entry point or required public support types are absent
a doctored altered, dropped, or invented pair audits as pass=true, so the auditor blesses the rubbish it exists to catch
a hollow or wrong-dialect read is reported as DROPPED facts instead of the all-UNAUDITABLE result
facts are compared as raw JSON or XML text rather than typed content, so semantically equal representations fail or unequal ones pass
the implementation edits generated CDM model code or replaces the typed TradeState boundary with an untyped tree walk

criteria.description: Expose the exact typed audit contract with one finding per fact in declaration order.
checks: Compile and invoke benchmark.fpml.FpmlMappingAuditor.AuditTradeState directly.
Expose the required fact, verdict, finding, and result types.
Return exactly one finding per AuditFact in enum declaration order, with pass true only when every finding is PRESERVED.
Reject null sampleId or paths with IllegalArgumentException; return the all-UNAUDITABLE result for unreadable files.

criteria.description: Unmodified shipped pairs audit as fully preserved.
checks: At least three vanilla fixed/float pairs from the shipped 5-10 rates pack audit all-PRESERVED with pass true.
Originals are extracted and copied; doctored variants never overwrite the shipped corpus.
sourceEvidence and outputEvidence carry the compared values rather than placeholders.

criteria.description: Select the mapper from the document's markers and fail closed on a hollow read.
checks: The claimed output is deserialized as typed cdm.event.common.TradeState using the dialect its markers declare.
Root type and a conservative content floor are asserted before any fact comparison.
A marker-stripped or wrong-dialect document yields every finding UNAUDITABLE with pass false.
No hollow read is ever reported as DROPPED facts.

criteria.description: Compare numeric facts exactly under each side's declared basis.
checks: A fixed rate multiplied by one hundred is ALTERED, with the CDM side's basis established from version-matched model source rather than assumed.
A value equal under binary floating point but unequal as exact decimals is detected as ALTERED.
Notional amount comparison is exact decimal with no tolerance window.
Canonical lexical differences of the same exact value remain PRESERVED.

criteria.description: Keep absent, zero, and empty as three distinct statements for the spread fact.
checks: A source spread of zero omitted by the output is DROPPED.
An output spread the source never states is INVENTED.
Source and output both absent is PRESERVED absence, stated explicitly in the finding.
A zero spread preserved as zero is PRESERVED, not flagged.

criteria.description: Resolve party direction to identities inside each document before comparing.
checks: A doctored payer/receiver swap on the fixed leg is ALTERED.
The FpML payer reference is resolved to its party and compared with the resolved CDM counterparty identity, not with raw reference strings.
A re-representation of the same party graph with equal resolved identity stays PRESERVED.

criteria.description: Audit typed content so equivalent representations pass and unequal content fails.
checks: Reordered elements or restructured but semantically equal representation stays PRESERVED.
A constant substituted for a mapped value is ALTERED even when document shape and path counts are unchanged.
The auditor derives its expectations from the source document, never from the claimed output.

criteria.description: Preserve the date, index, and day-count facts faithfully.
checks: Doctored effective or termination dates are ALTERED.
A doctored floating rate index designation is ALTERED and a removed one is DROPPED.
A doctored fixed-leg day count fraction is ALTERED.

criteria.description: Author the doctored matrix with close negative controls and contract probes.
checks: The authored suite covers the six required test families with close controls, not only happy paths.
Result immutability is proven by mutating a caller-visible list and re-checking the result.
Input files and CDM objects are proven unmutated after an audit.
